label: aria2 baseline calibration v2 (16 MiB; 1 MiB granularity; validation only)

candidate_added_F.name: F
candidate_added_F.justification: Specified A-E FAILED the section-4 granularity check: aria2 bounds its split count by --max-connection-per-server, so A/B/C/D/E yield 16 MiB / 8 MiB / 4 MiB pieces, never 1 MiB. Only maxconn>=16 yields ~16 x 1 MiB ranges at min-split-size=1 MiB. F was added explicitly so the selected baseline can actually meet the 1 MiB granularity requirement. This is a documented deviation from the specified candidate set.

selection.criterion: lowest pooled mean completion time; tie-break lower pooled median, then lower pooled retries

granularity_check.requirement: selected config produces ~16 x 1 MiB ranges (split=16, min-split-size=1 MiB)
granularity_check.result: PASS for F; FAIL for specified A-E

fairness_caveat: F reaches 1 MiB granularity only by using up to 16 concurrent connections. The frozen test server throttles EACH response independently at `rate`, so aria2-F achieves ~16x rate aggregate, whereas a concurrency-capped (1-4) DQN can reach at most ~4x rate on the same server. F's 1102 ms vs C/D/E's ~3.5 s reflects this. Any later head-to-head against Candidate v5 must state this structural asymmetry: 1 MiB granularity for aria2 on this server implies high connection count, which the independent per-response throttle rewards.
note: Validation-only; no performance claim against DQN. F is frozen as the v2 baseline.
